{{Quote|This is an excellent credit opportunity for a pilot such as you. What do you say to three hundred cred per kill... and a tiny bit of my respect when you're finished?|Rodian Base Security Chief to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rodian Base Security Chief''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] member of [[Sordaan Xris]]' [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] operations in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[File:Rodian_Base_Security_Chief_Decimator.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Rodian's [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]].]]
He was part of Rodian Security Command and oversaw the security of [[Sordaan's Rodian Hunter Outpost]]. He could often be seen patrolling the area around the station in his [[VT-49 Decimator/Legends|VT-49 Decimator]]. Near the station he met a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who agreed to take on the [[Gotal Bandits]] that had been a problem for the Rodians since they came to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
